data.name: StalSide
data.detailed_description:
StalSide is a coop like rogue-lite survival game set inside a mysterious, simulated post-apocalyptic world. The simulation is populated by both simple creatures and mysterious entities – some guarding its secrets, others unleashing chaos. Only the player has the capability to reveal simulation secrets. But beware: the simulation itself actively hinders intruders to maintain its balance between the known and unknown, so survival is a constant struggle.

Gameplay & Features:

Procedural Exploration: Each game session is unpredictable with a wild zones, random loot and spawn. No two expeditions are the same.

Cooperative Play: Team up online with up to 8 players to explore and survive together. Share resources and cover each other’s backs as you push deeper into the rabbit's hole.

Survival Mechanics: Scavenge for materials to craft weapons, tools, and shelter. You can face an enemies ranging from wild animals to hostile humans. And even face the unknown creatures that never seen before. The Zone is full of deadly traps – from the weather and deadly anomalies that can kill on sight.

Light Progression: There’s a minimal leveling system for slight stat boosts, but the focus remains on action and teamwork rather than grinding.

Anime-Style Visual: The game features colorful, anime-inspired characters that can be customized with a various clothes.

data.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.
